capabilities: Animate Graph view with a self-moving amoeba note that links and unlinks with other notes
Generate a daily abstract poem from words pulled from visited notes
Log broken links the amoeba encounters into a checkable cleanup list
Customize movement via speed, simultaneous links, pseudopods, and movement presets
disambiguation: Despite generating poems, it uses no AI or machine learning; poems are assembled by predefined rules and random variation from vault words.
extras: Warns that it can spike CPU usage while Graph view is open and is not recommended for very large vaults; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; development supported via Ko-fi donations.
motivation: The author felt graph view becomes stale and motionless, and that ideas are organic and always changing, so the technology should reflect that.
problem: Graph view is a static, motionless overview of the vault that looks the same every day, and broken links are easy to miss.

relations.evidence: The poem feature uses spencer kelly's compromise.js library for language processing

summary: Graph view animation plugin that adds a moving 'Amoeba' note which links and unlinks with vault notes, writes daily poems, and logs broken links.
